nodes.label: Product Requirements PRD v1.0
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: MVP initiation draft dated 2026-07-02 for adult couples; P0/P1/P2 denote required/planned priorities, not implementation status.

nodes.label: Required MVP Record Respond Revisit Recap Loop
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: Record a moment, partner responds, both revisit time views, recap or pet feedback encourages further recording.
nodes.rationale: Preserve pairing, basic recording, shared visibility, revisiting, privacy and unbinding if resources require scope cuts.

nodes.label: Required Pairing ACC01 ACC09
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: WeChat login, independent unpaired use, at most one active couple, hashed one-use 24h invitations, explicit acceptance, single-party unbind, ownership isolation and deletion status.

nodes.label: Required Moment Recording MOM01 MOM11
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: 1-9 images or one video or text, optional 30-character title, 1000-character body, past time or at most five minutes future, mood/events, explicit visibility, 3-second draft save, retries, editing and 30-day trash.

nodes.label: Required Template Composition IMG01 IMG06
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: At least six configurable styles with crop/date/text/stickers; 1-image poster, 2-4-image collage, 5-9-image cover; immutable originals and versioned derivatives.
nodes.rationale: Controlled composition gives stable results and predictable cost and privacy review; generative imagery is deferred.

nodes.label: Required Interactions INT01 INT06
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: Authorized shared moments, six fixed reactions, one reaction per user/moment, own-deletable single-level comments up to 300 characters, in-app messages, reminder preferences and feedback.

nodes.label: Required Time Views TIM01 TIM05
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: Day/week/month/year/custom views, date anchors, server-side time and authorization filters, stable secondary ordering and factual gentle statistics.
nodes.rationale: Make memories easy to revisit without diagnosing relationship quality from record counts or mood tags.

nodes.label: Required Cloud Pet PET01 PET07
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: One couple pet, three species, joint first-adoption confirmation, daily feed/play once each per actor, capped reward settlement, ten nondecreasing levels, 30-day log and freeze on unbind.
nodes.rationale: Offer shared feedback without death, missed-day penalties or partner contribution rankings.

nodes.label: Required Annual Recap REV01 REV09
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: Natural-year candidates, manual low-material option, PRIVATE exclusion, sensitive opt-in, editable chapters, story pages/paginated long images, async jobs, share disclosure and deletable versions.

nodes.label: Required Privacy SAFE01 SAFE06
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: On-demand consent, current server authorization for records/media/recaps, moderation and appeals, immutable privacy audit, traceable deletion and short media URLs.
nodes.rationale: Protect private shared memories across lists, messages, links, derived works, unbinding, deletion and backup recovery.

nodes.label: Planned Feature Roadmap P1 P2
nodes.source_file: graphify-out/converted/恋爱笔记_微信小程序产品需求文档_PRD_v1.0_7a232317.md
nodes.description: v1.1: partner perspective, daily questions, countdowns, 30/60-second video recap and generative backgrounds; v1.2: search, footprints, capsules, export and pet rooms; v2.0: print, membership, family and AI stories.
nodes.rationale: Gate expansion on a stable MVP, actual usage, budget, commercial support and content/privacy review.
